title: Champion re-baseline at matched snapshot — macro beats the champion (both cells)
summary: Re-baselined both committed champions at snapshot 2026-06-20 by reproducing their exact winning config (min_child_weight=10 on all 279 features, single fit — no agent loop needed) and ran a matched macro arm (same HP + 9-series macro panel). Removes BOTH the window and tuning-mode confounds from the _260 head-to-head. Result REVERSES _260: with HP held fixed, macro beats the champion's config on BOTH cells at nearly every K (+50% R-p@1 0.540->0.680, beating even the champion's all-time 0.640; +20% R-p@1 0.280->0.373). The _260 'sign-flip' was a default-auto-loop artifact (per-arm HP divergence), not a macro property. Promising but one-window + HP-sensitive + HY-OAS still a proxy -> recommend multi-window validation before deploy.
method: hp_starting {min_child_weight:10} + max_iterations 1 (single fit) reproduces the champions' exact config; macro arm identical except candidates: all_macro (9-series, 45 macro cols). trailing split, snapshot 2026-06-20.
